facts.fact: Seedtag describes CTV advertising as ads delivered through Connected TV environments, including streaming platforms and smart TV applications.

facts.fact: Seedtag defines contextual advertising as placing ads based on the content a person is engaging with, rather than personal browsing history or identifiers.
facts.quote: Contextual advertising places ads based on the content a person is engaging with, rather than personal browsing history or identifiers.

facts.fact: Seedtag defines Neuro-Contextual Advertising as an evolution of contextual advertising that uses AI to understand interest, emotion, and intent within content.
facts.quote: Neuro-Contextual Advertising is an evolution of contextual advertising that uses AI to understand interest, emotion, and intent within content.

facts.fact: According to Seedtag, ad blocking and ad fraud remain significant obstacles in CTV targeting, and measurement and tracking of TV campaigns still have difficulties.
facts.quote: Ad blocking and ad fraud also continue to be significant obstacles in CTV targeting.
